header.title: Documents Required
header.subtitle: Essential compliance and paperwork guidelines for smooth customs clearance.

categories.title: Gifts
categories.description: When sending gifts to India, customs requires verification of the recipient.
documents: Photo ID proof of the consignee (Any one: Passport, Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, or PAN Card)
Authorization letter from the consignee (if applicable)

categories.title: Personal Belongings
categories.description: For shipping unaccompanied baggage or personal effects.
documents: Consignee's Passport copy (Front and back pages)
Valid Visa copy or Residence Permit
Air ticket copy or Boarding pass

categories.title: Commercial Shipments
categories.description: Standard documentation required for standard B2B imports and exports.
documents: Commercial Invoice with complete item description and HS Codes
Complete KYC documents of the entity

categories.title: Sample Shipments
categories.description: For trade samples and prototypes sent for evaluation.
documents: Sample Proforma Invoice clearly marked as 'Free Trade Sample - No Commercial Value'
KYC documents of the sending/receiving company

categories.title: Repair & Return
categories.description: For sending equipment or parts abroad for repair and returning them.
documents: Original Export Shipping Bill / Bill of Entry
Repair Invoice from the overseas facility
Original Guarantee / Warranty card clearly stating the serial number
